claim: For the countable metric star \(S=\bigvee_{i\in\mathbb N}[0,\infty)_i\) with all origins identified and the path metric, let \(\mathcal C(S)\) be the nonempty closed connected subsets with the extended Hausdorff topology. Its connected components coincide with its path-connected components and are exactly the finite-Hausdorff-distance classes; for origin-containing sets with endpoint profiles \(a,b\in[0,\infty]^{\mathbb N}\), these classes are characterized by \(\{i:a_i=\infty\}=\{i:b_i=\infty\}\) and \(\sup_{i:a_i<\infty}|a_i-b_i|<\infty\). There are exactly \(2^{\aleph_0}\) components.

scientific_limitations_and_integrity.domain: Nonempty closed connected subsets of the countable metric star with extended Hausdorff topology.
limitations: Does not classify arbitrary infinite trees or \(C_n(S)\) for \(n\ge2\).
No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.proof_basis: Explicit profile classification, exact Hausdorff-distance formula, continuous interpolation, and a cardinality upper/lower bound.

title: Path components of the connected-closed hyperspace of a countable metric star
